visibility: Evaluator-only sidecar. Never serialize this file, derivations, expected outputs or oracle hashes into model messages.
grading_policy: Strict bounded JSON parsing, duplicate-key rejection, exact key sets and JSON types, then semantic equality to independently checked expected objects. Reject booleans as integers, non-finite numbers and malformed ISO dates. Object key order and whitespace do not affect correctness; array order is significant.
